automated_backups_configured.title: Automated Backups Configured
automated_backups_configured.description: Authorized backup tool runs scheduled/automated backups of in-scope assets (CIS 11.2). Secure true.

backup_rpo_hours.title: Backup Recovery Point Objective (Hours)
backup_rpo_hours.description: Recovery point objective in hours; <=168 (weekly or tighter) secure (CIS 11.2; M1053).

data_recovery_process_documented.title: Data Recovery Process Documented
data_recovery_process_documented.description: Documented data-recovery process reviewed annually (CIS 11.1). Secure true.

backups_encrypted.title: Backups Encrypted at Rest
backups_encrypted.description: Backup data encrypted at rest on the backup store (CIS 11.3 / NIST SP 800-209). Secure true.

backups_encrypted_in_transit.title: Backups Encrypted in Transit
backups_encrypted_in_transit.description: Backup data encrypted in transit to/from the destination (CIS 11.3). Secure true.

backup_keys_in_separate_trust_domain.title: Backup Keys in Separate Trust Domain
backup_keys_in_separate_trust_domain.description: Backup encryption keys held in a separate trust domain from production data-tier credentials (NIST SP 800-209). Secure true.

backup_immutability_enabled.title: Backup Immutability Enabled
backup_immutability_enabled.description: WORM immutability enabled on the backup store (S3 Object Lock / vault lock). Anti-ransomware. Secure true.

object_lock_retention_mode.title: Object Lock Retention Mode
object_lock_retention_mode.description: Object Lock/WORM retention mode. COMPLIANCE = strong immutable (root cannot delete, retention cannot shorten); GOVERNANCE bypassable; NONE no lock. Secure value COMPLIANCE.

offline_airgapped_backup_exists.title: Offline / Air-Gapped Backup Exists
offline_airgapped_backup_exists.description: At least one offline/air-gapped/off-site recovery copy unreachable from production (CIS 11.4; M1053; 3-2-1). Secure true.

backup_copy_in_separate_account_or_regio.title: Backup Copy in Separate Account or Region
backup_copy_in_separate_account_or_regio.description: At least one backup copy in a separate cloud account/region/trust domain from production (CIS 11.4; M1053). Secure true.

backup_access_restricted.title: Backup Access Restricted to Separate Trust Domain
backup_access_restricted.description: Backup storage + restore path authenticate independently of primary-data credentials; delete/management least-privileged to a dedicated backup role (NIST SP 800-209; mitigates T1490). Secure true.

mfa_delete_enabled.title: MFA Delete Enabled
mfa_delete_enabled.description: Deleting a backup version or changing versioning/protection state requires a second factor (S3 MFA Delete). Secure true (mitigates T1490/T1485).

restoration_tested_rto.title: Restoration Tested with RTO Measured
restoration_tested_rto.description: Backup recovery exercised on cadence for a sampling of assets with RTO measured (CIS 11.5; M1053). Secure true.

restore_test_interval_days.title: Restore Test Interval (Days)
restore_test_interval_days.description: Days since last documented restore test; <=90 (quarterly) secure, >3 months non-compliant (CIS 11.5).

backup_integrity_verification.title: Backup Integrity Verification
backup_integrity_verification.description: Backups integrity-checked (checksums on write/restore-validation) so corruption/tamper detected before reliance (NIST SP 800-209; D3-RD). Secure true.

object_versioning_enabled.title: Object Versioning Enabled
object_versioning_enabled.description: Version history enabled on the backup store so a clean pre-incident version can be restored (M1053). Secure true.

point_in_time_recovery_enabled.title: Point-in-Time Recovery Enabled
point_in_time_recovery_enabled.description: PITR/continuous backup enabled so restore to a moment before corruption is possible. Secure true.

backup_retention_days.title: Backup Retention (Days)
backup_retention_days.description: Days the retention/versioning policy keeps recovery points; >=30 secure (must span detection window).

backup_job_monitoring_enabled.title: Backup Job Monitoring Enabled
backup_job_monitoring_enabled.description: Backup job success/failure + Object Lock/versioning state changes actively monitored (NIST SP 800-209; CIS 11.1). Secure true.

backup_failure_alerting_enabled.title: Backup Failure Alerting Enabled
backup_failure_alerting_enabled.description: Backup-job failures and protection-state changes raise an alert (CIS 11.1). Secure true.
